facts.fact: The UN Resident Coordinator's foreword to the AI strategy, signed in a document dated 13 February 2026, calls the National Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029 'recently launched'; no adopting act or body is named, and the document gives no launch date, so the document's own date is used.

note: The document is the AI strategy (thematic); the one fact is about the Blueprint, classed national from the document's account of its four pillars (including Economy) and its five enablers of government.
